title: How Jason Calacanis built a media career from zines to All-In: skills, ranking, and podcast consistency
summary: Jason recounts going from Brooklyn night-school kid to zine publisher, blog-network founder (Weblogs Inc, sold to AOL) and podcaster. Key lessons: self-teach the skills a product needs, use media to gain influence, hold consistency across 100 episodes, and let a podcast feed an investing business. Much of the Kanye/Elon chatter comes from the host, not Jason.

principles.text: Learn the skills your product needs; 60-70% proficiency is enough to know who to hire for the other 20-30%.
principles.quote: I believe you can get to 60 or 70 Proficiency in any uh discipline if you just put your mind to it that doesn't mean you're gonna become great at it but you only really need 60 70 percent to be able to figure out who has the 80 or 90 that you could hire
